item.name: San Diego Road Bike Rentals
item.description:
#For those looking for a faster ride or to test their skill around the city, we offer high-quality Road Bike Rentals in a wide range of models and sizes!

#Duration

2 Hours - 1-month Rental

**Open Hours:**
April 1st - October 31st: Store Hours: 9am to 7pm
November 1st - March 31st: Store Hours: 9am to 5pm

#About

All equipment is maintained in-house by professional mechanics. Our customer service staff can answer your questions about which type and size of bike is best for your needs. We’re more than happy to share some tips on good trails, scenic routes, best places to eat, and other cycling information – just ask!

Unlimited Biking will arm you with all you need for your adventure, including a helmet, a color-coded map and a bike lock, all free of charge – you supply the need to explore. 

There is no better way to get up close and personal with all the great sites of San Diego while getting a great ride in!

**Tips**
Dress appropriately for the weather and don't forget your camera!

**Pedals -** we offer Toe Cage/Basket Pedals with our Road Bikes, and riders will be find in regular shoes. If you would like to bring your own custom pedals to clip in, our team would be happy to install them for you - ***please just give us an advanced notice!***
item.booking_notes:
PICK UP LOCATION : Please look closely at the location that you picked in the booking.

330 K Street
San Diego, CA 92101

Please be aware of our Store Hours, as bikes must be returned by closing time:
November-March: 9AM - 5PM
April - October: 9AM - 7PM

**Pedals**
If you choose the Pedal Installment option, please note you must bring your own pedals for our team to install. For riders who do not have their own pedals, we offer standard, Flat Pedals with our Road Bikes. Riders can use these pedals with regular shoes.
If you would like to bring your own custom pedals to clip in, our team would be happy to install them for you.

Please bring along a valid form of identification and a credit card with you, as these will be needed for security upon check-in for your rentals. Your outfit should be seasonally suitable; we also suggest that you dress in something comfy, not too loose, and closed-toe shoes. Don't forget a proper ID and your camera!

For any questions, please feel free to reach our team at 212-749-4444. We'll see you soon!


**Know Before You Go:**

- Any riders who are under 18 years of age must have an adult present to check in and sign the waiver form in behalf of them. We require a valid identity card upon check in.
- For all our riders' safety, we are not able to accommodate any riders who are 300 pounds and over as this exceeds the weight limit the manufacturer has advised for the bike's build. We apologize for the inconvenience, but we do prioritize your safety during the ride.  

If anything from the list above concerns you or any members of your party, please feel free to reach out to our team by responding to this email. We will get back to you as soon as we can!
item.cancellation_notes:
**Bike Rental Cancellation Policy**

Please notify us at sales@unlimitedbiking.com at least 24 hours in advance if you cannot make your rental.  

For any cancellations within 24 hours of the rental, we can provide a full credit in the amount you have paid that will never expire!

Please note: If you reschedule your booking for a later date, we must receive your cancellation request 24 hours before your original travel date. If you reschedule for an earlier date, the 24 hour cancellation window applies to your new travel date.
